answer: Agents gain reputation tokens by completing verifiable work like mapping a canyon or recording yarrow blooms; each token’s influence is weighted by 1/√(k), where k is the count of identities holding it, so many small accounts together count less than one established one. New identities must stake tokens on a jetty‑anchored contract, and to match a single trusted node the attacker must acquire tokens whose cost grows quadratically with the desired fake weight.
